headline: Why has he gone cold on me?
note:
🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework. Bubbles 3-6 run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why — and the read ANSWERS. The art line and the bridge are unchanged. Every ban in this note still stands.

Face-down only (return-mhf). 🔴 NO VERDICT EITHER WAY — 'he is losing interest' convicts him, 'he still loves you' reassures on his behalf, and 'nothing has gone wrong' is the same reassurance in a smaller coat. 🔴 NO CHASE STRATEGY, which is what the whole internet sells against this headline: no giving him space, no pulling back, no matching his energy, no going quiet so he chases. 🔴 Never blame her — nothing about being too much, too eager, moving too fast, or what she should have held back.

Finding: the temperature drop is real and she is not making it up — but 'cold' describes what reached her, not what is in him, and the difference is the only honest thing anyone can offer.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — the coin on his table has a star drawn inside a circle.
You asked why he has gone cold on you. Your hand went to the man who once made warmth on purpose.
So the warmth was real, dear. It was made, not made up.
And warmth like that gets made on purpose, dear. He built it.
But what reaches you now has changed, dear. You felt the drop.
That's why you go back over that week, dear, hunting the day it turned.
Let me look closer at what has come between you and that warmth…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — the leaves on his beam are the only green in the picture.
You asked why he has gone cold on you. Your hand went to the card that freezes a thing.
So the whole thing has gone still, dear. You felt that happen.
And green still shows on that wood, dear, while nothing else moves.
But cold describes what reached you, dear. Not what sits in him.
That's why nothing you try warms it, dear. You're working the wrong end.
Let me look closer at what has settled over this…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — he wears a wreath of green leaves on his head.
You asked why he has gone cold on you. Your hand went to the one who doesn't look back.
So you've been hunting for the moment it turned. There may not be one, dear.
And he walks on, dear, with no account of it left behind him.
But the card gives no reason for the change, dear. Only that it came.
That's why you keep asking, dear, and nobody will answer it.
Let me look closer at what has been chilling this…
